courier-relay/protocol-negotiation: courier-relay/protocol-negotiation: Request protocol resolution and error contract, established while implementing trial-bk7 (count command). An omitted "protocol" field selects CURRENT_PROTOCOL ("1" as of this issue). An explicit protocol value not in the supported set returns {"error": "unsupported_protocol"} (no other fields), matching the style of the existing {"error": "unknown_command"} response for unrecognized commands. This is an inferred-but-reasonable extension of the spec text ("Explicit supported protocols select that version...") since the spec does not literally state the unsupported-protocol response shape; no alternate wording was specified or rejected. When a new protocol version becomes current, add its value to SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS in main.py and update CURRENT_PROTOCOL, but keep prior protocol values in SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS so older explicit-protocol requests (including public test suites that pin a protocol) keep working, per the AGENTS.md contract that explicit versions remain supported after a new current version is introduced.
